product_metadata.title: Madison Starlite Deluxe Swag Ruby Shower Curtain, No Size
features: Coordinates with Star lite Shower Curtain
Set includes a shower curtain liner, two easy to attach tieback hooks, and two ruffled tiebacks
description: Star lite Deluxe Swag ruffled Shower Curtain will update and beautify your bath's decor. Jacquard woven diamonds will shimmer like a reflection on a clear pool. Star lite is made from water resistant polyester fabric. Set includes a liner, two easy to attach tieback hooks, and two ruffled tiebacks. Coordinating 63" ruffled window curtain is also available.
